# Vaydin

> Vaydin finds the patients a clinic never saw, and books them. Dubai aesthetic clinics. Measured, not promised.

Vaydin (VAYDIN PARTNERS INVESTMENTS - FZCO, Dubai Silicon Oasis, UAE) works with aesthetic clinics in Dubai and the MENA region in three steps:

1. Diagnose: an unannounced mystery shop of the clinic, the way a patient meets it (WhatsApp, Google, Instagram, the website, the booking link), scored across six dimensions, plus a recurring sweep of everything a patient can find.
2. Fix and run: the Vaydin engine takes over the clinic's digital front door, under the clinic's own name and number: WhatsApp messages answered in minutes, reviews answered, bookings made and reminded, old inquiries revived.
3. Grow: once the engine runs the clinic, paid patient demand lands in a machine built to convert it.
